query.sql: SELECT v.scenario_name, x."口径", x."收益率（%）" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('隐含收益率', round((v.implied_irr * 100)::numeric, 2)), ('现金支持口径', round((v.cash_implied_irr * 100)::numeric, 2)), ('要求收益率', round((v.required_return * 100)::numeric, 2))) x("口径", "收益率（%）") ORDER BY v.sort, 2

SELECT x.price AS "买入价", '隐含收益率' AS "系列", round((vi_irr(f.divs, f.taus, f.td, f.ttau, f.cf_g, x.price) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS "收益率" FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id AND s.is_base JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(15, 40) x(price) UNION ALL SELECT x.price, '要求收益率', round((f.required_return * 100)::numeric, 2) FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id AND s.is_base JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(15, 40) x(price) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT round((x.r * 100)::numeric, 1)::text || '%' AS "要求收益率", s.name AS "情景", round(vi_pv(f.divs, f.taus, f.td, f.ttau, f.cf_g, x.r)::numeric, 2) AS "最高买入价", x.r, s.sort FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN (SELECT generate_series(40, 90, 5) / 1000.0 AS r) x UNION ALL SELECT round((x.r * 100)::numeric, 1)::text || '%', '市场价', round(cc.latest_price::numeric, 2), x.r, 99 FROM vi_model_base m JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN (SELECT generate_series(40, 90, 5) / 1000.0 AS r) x ORDER BY 4, 5

SELECT v.scenario_name, round(v.value_today::numeric, 2) AS "今天每股价值" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY v.sort

SELECT v.scenario_name, '今天价值' AS item, round(v.value_today::numeric, 2) AS price, v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' UNION ALL SELECT v.scenario_name, '低档关注价', round(v.watch_low::numeric, 2), v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' UNION ALL SELECT v.scenario_name, '高档关注价', round(v.watch_high::numeric, 2), v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' UNION ALL SELECT v.scenario_name, '市场价', round(v.market_price::numeric, 2), v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY sort, item

SELECT v.scenario_name, round(v.terminal_share::numeric, 4) AS "终值占比" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY v.sort

SELECT p.year, x.item, round(x.amount::numeric, 1) AS amount FROM vi_projection p JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = p.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('归母净利润', p.np_parent), ('计划股息', p.dividend), ('FCFE', p.fcfe)) x(item, amount) WHERE p.is_base ORDER BY p.year, x.item

SELECT round((s.r * 100)::numeric, 2)::text || '%' AS r, 'g=' || round((s.g * 100)::numeric, 2)::text || '%' AS g, round(s.value_today::numeric, 2) AS value FROM vi_sensitivity s JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = s.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY s.r, s.g

SELECT h.year::text AS year, '历史' AS kind, round(h.interest_debt::numeric, 0) AS debt FROM vi_fin_history_base h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.is_default WHERE h.interest_debt IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.year::text, '预测', round(fc.debt_close::numeric, 0) FROM vi_forecast_base f JOIN vi_forecast_calc fc USING (id) JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY year

SELECT h.year, x.item, x.amount FROM vi_fin_history_base h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.is_default CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('归母净利润', h.np_parent), ('现金分红', h.dividend_total)) x(item, amount) WHERE x.amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item
SELECT h.year, round(h.volume::numeric, 0) AS "业务量" FROM vi_fin_history_base h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.is_default WHERE h.volume IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year

SELECT d.period, round((d.yoy * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "同比（%）" FROM vi_period_data_base d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.is_default WHERE d.period_kind = '单季' AND d.yoy IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.period_end

SELECT k.result, count(*) AS n FROM vi_check k JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = k.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.is_default JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' GROUP BY k.result ORDER BY k.result
SELECT f.verify_status, count(*) AS n FROM vi_fact_base f JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = f.company_id AND co.is_default GROUP BY f.verify_status ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT o.obs_date, o.value AS "股价" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.price_metric_id = o.metric_id AND co.is_default ORDER BY o.obs_date
SELECT o.obs_date, o.value AS "数值" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_metric_base mt ON mt.id = o.metric_id WHERE mt.code = 'CGB10Y.CCDC' ORDER BY o.obs_date
SELECT o.obs_date, o.value AS "数值" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_metric_base mt ON mt.id = o.metric_id WHERE mt.code = 'SX.LEVEL' ORDER BY o.obs_date
